dedupe_keys.name: chinese city power emissions calculation code

description: The Chinese city power-emissions team publishes MATLAB calculation code for its historical prefectural generation and carbon estimates. The Figshare record lists two Code.m files, and the article says MATLAB and Excel routines generated estimates for 352 cities from 2000 to 2019. Source files are publicly accessible under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The code may help reproduce city-level inputs for energy-transition simulations with model-pypsa after matching data schemas. A caveat is that two same-named files in the deposit need inspection to establish their distinct roles; the metadata do not expose an installation guide, dependencies or complete input sources. A calculated city estimate is not a direct plant meter reading. The own record and article code statement were read without downloading the scripts or rerunning the allocation. The resulting Excel city-year table is a separate Figshare resource and record.
